basic_info.description: This quintessential Russian Hill condo boasts two bedrooms, one bath, and original architectural details. Details include beautiful hardwood floors, wainscoting, and bay windows. The chic living area offers outlooks to the Bay and of Alcatraz, features a wet bar, and decorative fireplace. The living area seamlessly flows into the dining area and is open to the kitchen. The open concept living area benefits from multiple windows that allow natural light to pour throughout the residence. Both bedrooms are sizable and offer proper closets. Down the hall is an office alcove providing flexibility for those who work-from-home. Additional storage and common area laundry complete this unit. Ideally positioned between restaurant/shops along Polk Street, Washington Square, and Columbus Avenue. Close proximity to George Sterling Park and public transit options.
